name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the generated response aligns with the context and topic of the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the originality and inventiveness of the response, and how well it adds to the conversation.

name: Clarity
description: Assesses the clarity and comprehensibility of the response, ensuring it is easy to understand and follows a logical structure.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how engaging and interesting the response is, including its ability to spark further conversation.

name: Fact Integration
description: Evaluates how well the response incorporates the interesting fact provided into the continuation of the conversation.
